passage:
Add a bit more

Read this poem about Sam and me (Jodie) making a birthday cake.
A special day needs a special treat.
A present? or something nice to eat?

1.

4.
‘Here’s some cherries and chocolate drops,’
‘And let’s add strawberry jam.’

We’re making a birthday cake for Mum.

‘Do you think that Mum will like our cake?’

Just from Sam and me.

‘Of course,’ I say to Sam.

It’s easy as pie and lots of fun.

So into the bowl and mix it around

We saw it on TV.

Then add a bit more,

Just into the bowl and mix it around,

And add a bit more.

Then add a bit more,

Don’t tread in the pool on the floor!

And add a bit more,

5.

But don’t let it drip on the floor!

2.

‘It’s still a bit lumpy. Let’s add some milk.’
‘Be careful how you pour!

‘What kinds of things do you put in cakes?’

There’s not much room left in the bowl.

‘Good things,’ says Sam to me.

We don’t want it spilt on the floor.’

‘Butter and eggs and chocolate sauce,

So into the bowl and mix it around,

As easy as one, two, three.’

Then add a bit more,

Now into the bowl and mix it around,

And add a bit more.

Then add a bit more,

There’s quite a lot on the floor!

And add a bit more.

6.

I think there’s a drip on the floor!

3.

‘I think Mum will get a big surprise,
Don’t you?’ says Sam to me.

‘I’ve found a can of apple sauce,

‘I’m sure she will,’ I say to Sam,

And I think we should use flour.’

‘Let’s call her to come and see.’

‘Lots of sugar too,’ says Sam,

So into the bowl and mix it around,

‘It tastes a little sour.’

Then add a bit more,

So into the bowl and mix it around

And add a bit more.

Then add a bit more,

Oh! Look at the mess on the floor!

And add a bit more.
Watch out for the drips on the floor!

‘What a lovely thought,’ says Mum with the mop.
‘Now who would like a treat at the ice cream shop?’
Elaine Horsfield

questions.stem: Why was Sam helping Jodie make a cake?
options: It was for their mother’s birthday.
They had seen how easy it was on TV.

questions.stem:

The children added [Choose 1…] to the mixture because it was a bit lumpy.

Which statements are correct? Choose two.
options: The children let Mum clean up after them.
The children followed a recipe to make the cake.
The cake mixture would be very sweet.
Mum bought ice cream to put on the cake.
Mum put the cake in the oven.

questions.stem: What is the most likely reason there was a mess on the floor?
options: The children were trying to make a mess.
There were too many children helping make the cake.
After adding the milk the mixture got very sloppy.
The bowl was too small for mixing all the added ingredients.
